mapper.select:
SELECT BS.BOOKSET_ID as booksetId, BS.SUBJECT_NO as subjectNo, BS.SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName, BS.FSUBJECT_ID as fsubjectId, BS.BAL_FLAG as balFlag, BS.SUBJECT_TYPE as subjectType, BS.SUBJECT_LEVEL as subjectLevel, BS.ACC_QUA_FLAG as accQuaFlag, BS.ACC_INT_FLAG as accIntFlag, BS.OVERDRAWN_FLAG as overdrawnFlag, BS.BASE_SUBJECT_NATURE as baseSubjectNature, BS.GEN_DETSUB_FLAG as genDetsubFlag, BS.CCY as ccy, BS.SUBJECT_INTERNAL_CODE as subjectInternalCode, BS.SUBJECT_HAND_FEL_CODE as subjectHandFelCode, BS.CREATE_USER as createUser, BS.CREATE_DEPT as createDept, BS.CREATE_TIME as createTime, BS.UPDATE_USER as updateUser, BS.UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, BOK_BOND_TYPE.HAND_CODE_VALUE as bokBondType, BOK_BOND_TYPE2.HAND_CODE_VALUE as bokBondType2, BOK_TRD_MARKET.HAND_CODE_VALUE as bokTrdMarket, BOK_ISSUE_TYPE.HAND_CODE_VALUE as bokIssueType, BOK_CPY_TYPE.HAND_CODE_VALUE as bokCpyType,
BOK_ACCOUNT_TYPE.HAND_CODE_VALUE as bokAccountType, BOK_FEE_TYPE.HAND_CODE_VALUE as bokFeeType, BOK_TRD_PROP.HAND_CODE_VALUE as bokTrdProp, BOK_TAX_TYPE.HAND_CODE_VALUE as bokTaxType, BOK_CPY.HAND_CODE_VALUE as bokCpy FROM BOK_SUBJECT BS LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT_HAND_VALUE BOK_BOND_TYPE on BS.BOOKSET_ID=BOK_BOND_TYPE.BOOKSET_ID and BS.SUBJECT_NO=BOK_BOND_TYPE.SUBJECT_NO and BOK_BOND_TYPE.HAND_CODE='BOK_BOND_TYPE' LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT_HAND_VALUE BOK_BOND_TYPE2 on BS.BOOKSET_ID=BOK_BOND_TYPE2.BOOKSET_ID and BS.SUBJECT_NO=BOK_BOND_TYPE2.SUBJECT_NO and BOK_BOND_TYPE2.HAND_CODE='BOK_BOND_TYPE2' LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT_HAND_VALUE BOK_TRD_MARKET on BS.BOOKSET_ID=BOK_TRD_MARKET.BOOKSET_ID and BS.SUBJECT_NO=BOK_TRD_MARKET.SUBJECT_NO and BOK_TRD_MARKET.HAND_CODE='BOK_TRD_MARKET' LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT_HAND_VALUE BOK_ISSUE_TYPE on BS.BOOKSET_ID=BOK_ISSUE_TYPE.BOOKSET_ID and BS.SUBJECT_NO=BOK_ISSUE_TYPE.SUBJECT_NO and BOK_ISSUE_TYPE.HAND_CODE='BOK_ISSUE_TYPE' LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT_HAND_VALUE BOK_CPY_TYPE on BS.BOOKSET_ID=BOK_CPY_TYPE.BOOKSET_ID and BS.SUBJECT_NO=BOK_CPY_TYPE.SUBJECT_NO and BOK_CPY_TYPE.HAND_CODE='BOK_CPY_TYPE'
LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT_HAND_VALUE BOK_ACCOUNT_TYPE on BS.BOOKSET_ID=BOK_ACCOUNT_TYPE.BOOKSET_ID and BS.SUBJECT_NO=BOK_ACCOUNT_TYPE.SUBJECT_NO and BOK_ACCOUNT_TYPE.HAND_CODE='BOK_ACCOUNT_TYPE' LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT_HAND_VALUE BOK_FEE_TYPE on BS.BOOKSET_ID=BOK_FEE_TYPE.BOOKSET_ID and BS.SUBJECT_NO=BOK_FEE_TYPE.SUBJECT_NO and BOK_FEE_TYPE.HAND_CODE='BOK_FEE_TYPE' LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT_HAND_VALUE BOK_TRD_PROP on BS.BOOKSET_ID=BOK_TRD_PROP.BOOKSET_ID and BS.SUBJECT_NO=BOK_TRD_PROP.SUBJECT_NO and BOK_TRD_PROP.HAND_CODE='BOK_TRD_PROP' LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT_HAND_VALUE BOK_TAX_TYPE on BS.BOOKSET_ID=BOK_TAX_TYPE.BOOKSET_ID and BS.SUBJECT_NO=BOK_TAX_TYPE.SUBJECT_NO and BOK_TAX_TYPE.HAND_CODE='BOK_TAX_TYPE' LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT_HAND_VALUE BOK_CPY on BS.BOOKSET_ID=BOK_CPY.BOOKSET_ID and BS.SUBJECT_NO=BOK_CPY.SUBJECT_NO and BOK_CPY.HAND_CODE='BOK_CPY'
where BS.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} AND BS.SUBJECT_NO = #{subjectNo}
SELECT SUBJECT_NO code,SUBJECT_NAME name,SUBJECT_NAME shortName,SUBJECT_NO hidCode,SUBJECT_NAME linkValue FROM BOK_SUBJECT

SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_NO id, SUBJECT_NAME text FROM BOK_SUBJECT
to_number(subject_level) = #{subjectLevel}
AND (SUBJECT_NO like '%' || #{search} || '%' OR SUBJECT_NAME like '%' || #{search} || '%')
order by SUBJECT_NO

SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_LEVEL id, SUBJECT_LEVEL text FROM BOK_SUBJECT
to_number(subject_level) >= ( select DISTINCT to_number(SUBJECT_LEVEL) from BOK_SUBJECT where SUBJECT_NO = #{subjectNo} )
AND SUBJECT_LEVEL = #{search}
order by SUBJECT_LEVEL

SELECT DISTINCT A.SUBJECT_NO code,A.SUBJECT_NAME name,A.SUBJECT_NAME shortName,A.SUBJECT_NO hidCode,A.SUBJECT_NAME linkValue FROM BOK_SUBJECT A LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT B ON A.SUBJECT_NO = B.FSUBJECT_ID WHERE B.SUBJECT_NO IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT A.SUBJECT_NO code,A.SUBJECT_NAME name,A.SUBJECT_NAME shortName,A.SUBJECT_NO hidCode,A.SUBJECT_NAME linkValue FROM BOK_SUBJECT A LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT B ON A.SUBJECT_NO = B.FSUBJECT_ID AND A.BOOKSET_ID = B.BOOKSET_ID WHERE B.SUBJECT_NO IS NOT NULL
AND (A.SUBJECT_NO like '%' || #{param} || '%' OR A.SUBJECT_NAME like '%' || #{param} || '%')
select count(1) from BOK_SUBJECT where BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId} and SUBJECT_NO = #{subjectNo}

SELECT DISTINCT SUBJECT_NAME text FROM BOK_SUBJECT
to_number(subject_level) = #{subjectLevel}
AND (SUBJECT_NO like '%' || #{search} || '%' OR SUBJECT_NAME like '%' || #{search} || '%')
order by SUBJECT_NAME
